title: EXPLOSIVES
body:
Discard 1 [grenadeToken].
Place a new Corridor between your Room
and another Explored Room.

OR

If you are in a Room with [yellowItem]: Gain 1 [grenadeToken]
layoutNotes: Full-frame illustrated card with a large central explosion and armored figures.
The title appears in a large black-and-gold plaque above the rules text.
Rules text is arranged as two alternatives separated by a centered OR divider.
A white weapon-like symbol crossed by a red X appears in the upper-right corner.
The footer label is centered at the bottom.
